title: Az Alkotmánybíróság és a jogállami garanciák (The Constitutional Court & Democratic Safeguards)
grammar: Constitutional Regimes, Rights Guarantees & Legal Terminology in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Constitutional Court and the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights do.
I can say what a cardinal law is and how many votes it needs.
I can use megsemmisít and kétharmados in a sentence.
I can read a short text about the Constitutional Court and answer questions about it.
